lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 12 distinct vertical white line segments; spacing is relatively uniform in the mid-torso with increased density observed in the anterior-shoulder region.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The first and second lines from the posterior are abbreviated segments; the second line exhibits a central vertical break; the final two lines on the anterior torso terminate before reaching the ventral midline.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A localized grouping of 4-5 high-contrast white spots is visible on the lower posterior haunch, positioned dorsal to the stifle joint.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Two spots on the lower haunch align on a near-horizontal axis, forming a semi-connected geometric pair.

other_distinctive_markers: Prominent white facial chevron between the eyes; white throat patch at the base of the neck; white interior ear markings.
